references.text: Earlier in the chapter, instructions are given to count the Israelites, and the twelve leaders from each tribe are mentioned by name, which verse 44 summarizes.
The second census on the plains of Moab, where Moses and Eleazar count the people in a similar manner.
The genealogy of Moses and Aaron, confirming their role as leaders over Israel.
The chiefs of Israel, heads of their families, the same who were leaders of the tribes and oversaw the numbering.
The leaders of the twelve tribes are represented by twelve staffs, one for each tribe, confirming the structure of twelve representatives.
